summary_en: 400,000 shares (0.47% S/O) up to ¥1,360M. Acquisition window August 14, 2026 (single day). Method not disclosed. Rationale: shareholder requests and shareholder returns policy.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On August 13, 2026, the board of MITANI CORPORATION (8066, TSE Standard) resolved to acquire treasury stock pursuant to the company's articles of incorporation and the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 400,000 ordinary shares at a maximum aggregate cost of ¥1,360,000,000. The acquisition window is set for August 14, 2026 (single-day execution). The 400,000-share limit represents 0.47% of shares outstanding (calculated as 400,000 ÷ 85,795,570 ex-treasury shares = 0.467%, rounded to 0.47%). No price ceiling per share was disclosed. The stated rationale is to address sale intentions from existing shareholders while supporting shareholder returns and capital-allocation strategy. The method of acquisition (ToSTNeT-3, open-market, or self-tender offer) is not specified in the filing.
